column1: # Script provenance manifest
# Declares, for every maintenance script under ~/Developer/scripts/, where the
# executed copy lives, where its recorded (version-controlled) mirror lives in
# this store, and which copy is authoritative.
# Format: <executed path><TAB><recorded path or -><TAB><authority>
#   authority is always `executed`: ~/Developer/scripts/ is what launchd runs,
#   and the store copy under scripts/ is a recorded mirror for history and
#   recovery. The store copy is never executed (no LaunchAgent references
#   openspec-store/scripts), so recording a script cannot change job behavior.
# A `-` in the recorded column means no recorded mirror exists yet; the drift
# check reports that as a missing record rather than as agreement.
# Drift between an executed copy and its recorded mirror is detected by SHA-256
# content digest (not mtime, not mode) and reported by the daily maintenance job
# as a degradation. Drift is never auto-repaired: reconciling requires a
# deliberate change.
# Maintained by: change version-workspace-scripts-and-detect-copy-drift
